items.claim: Apple frames design around purpose, agency, and understanding what matters most to the people using the experience.
Apple system colors are semantically defined, adapt across appearance contexts, and should not be reassigned to unrelated roles.
items.notes: Supports role-preserving token translation rather than copying hard-coded color values.

items.claim: Apple accessibility guidance treats sufficient foreground/background contrast and legibility as core interface requirements.
The transferable design intelligence is adaptive semantic behavior and platform fit, not a fixed visual skin that can be pasted onto arbitrary web products.
